mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in CPIAUCSL above 3% for three consecutive months signals entrenched inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to raise FEDFUNDS, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or FEDFUNDS does not increase following CPIAUCSL > 3.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in GDPC1 over two consecutive quarters indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and depresses S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 declines but S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in UNRATE above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and cost of goods sold, ultimately reducing profit margins and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive during more than 40% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO above its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months indicates expanding industrial production, which boosts corporate earnings and supports higher equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO remains above its 12-month MA but S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS and a rise in CPIAUCSL above 2.5% for two months signals monetary policy lag and ineffective inflation control, which erodes investor confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls while CPIAUCSL > 2.5% for 2 months
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL > 2.5% but S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A strong rebound in RSAFS above its 6-month moving average signals renewed consumer spending, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS exceeds its 6-month MA but S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A coordinated fall in both PAYEMS and UNRATE below 4% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer purchasing power and depresses S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS and UNRATE both < 4% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: Both PAYEMS and UNRATE fall below 4% but S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in HOUST above its 12-month moving average for three consecutive months indicates strengthening housing demand, which boosts construction and related equities, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST remains above its 12-month MA but S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.10).
